invariants: Every configured-engine RequestCreated log from the same successful transaction is parsed and bound to receipt transaction/block/hash/log identity; exact count, unique request/original/log identities, kind/type/quantity are checked. No payer query or adjacent ID inference is used.

Actual signed openPack/openPacks/claim calldata recovers historical missing purchase count and handles changed replacements; local hints cannot fabricate requests or block a legitimate changed original/quantity. Every direct getRequest must match its creation event.

Creation transaction/block/log identity is part of request/card query keys. All completed request card batches are verified before a single physical wrapper presents the combined cards in creation-log order.

Pending, seeded/recovery and indexer-delayed requests retain the group. Recovery controls target each exact request. Forfeitures are explicit and require acknowledgement before showing only the completed originals; no forfeited card is invented.
Transferred and burned historical cards retain request identity and are never filtered by current owner. Current daily claim beneficiary is not assumed to equal the old payer.

Stored hashes and optional count/type/quantity/original hints survive scoped reload/replacement; malformed optional hints preserve recoverable hashes. No local card payload or saved request ID is trusted as proof.
Latest five purchase/claim groups remain visible even after recovery/approval/burn transactions, alongside latest five transactions; storage remains bounded to thirty records.
Existing single opening, daily batch, keyboard, touch, cancelled-drag, mouth-clipping and one-tear animation behavior remain covered.

validation.reactReview: Hooks stay unconditional; bounded useQueries parallelize independent requests, declarative derived state, accessible dialog focus/cleanup/status/recovery controls, no added dependency or write flow.

remaining: Independent review and root canonical build/publication.
Multi-pack transactions stay disabled on the known original deployed implementation until its reviewed owner-signed contract upgrade; this package performs no upgrade.
